name: @stealtheye/quirt
description: StealthEye Quirt standalone UID-0 root-control daemon

scripts.test: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-lines=80 --test-coverage-functions=80 --test-coverage-branches=74 --test-coverage-exclude=.test-dist/canonical.js --test-coverage-exclude=.test-dist/quirt/*.test.js .test-dist/quirt/*.test.js
scripts.test:quirt-release: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-concurrency=1 .test-dist/quirt/release.test.js
